svg.title: Retro Music Toolkit: JSON score to rendered WAV
svg.desc: A JSON score on the left passes through the deterministic compiler and offline renderer, producing a piano roll, waveform, and measured render report on the right. The report shows -21.59 LUFS, -6.18 dBFS true peak, 1,411,200 frames, and zero clipped samples.
svg.text: JSON score → validated events → offline Tone.js render → reproducible WAV
no API, no GPU, no account
